entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. I bought a jersey, but I seem to have ordered the wrong size.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you happen to have the order number?
Yes, I have it right here. It's VF753-9012.
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Aero jersey. You mentioned it was the wrong size. Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's just a fit preference. The jersey is too tight in the arms. I should have sized up, so I was hoping to exchange it.

I see. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, it looks like your order was delivered 46 days ago, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for you.

That's excellent news. I appreciate that. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging it and sending it back, is there any possibility of getting a small credit or a discount code for a future purchase?

I understand the request. While we do provide a prepaid shipping label to make the process as easy as possible, our policy for a size exchange doesn't include promotional credits. I can get that label sent over to your email right away, though.
I see. So no discount, but the exchange itself is approved? And the return shipping is covered?

That's correct. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. You'll receive an email with the prepaid return label shortly. Just drop it off, and as soon as we scan it into our warehouse, the new size will be shipped out to you.
Alright, that works for me. It never hurts to ask. Thanks for making the exchange process straightforward.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Isaac.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
